description: Add a creator as a manual match to a campaign by profileId, with its fitScore. Idempotent on (campaign, profileId). Stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of the catalog profile, so the input carries nothing else, and any other key, platform or username included, fails the call with a validation error; a profileId with no catalog profile returns not_found. While a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, it returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

name: add_campaign_match
title: Add campaign match
